aki_journal.txt.content:
[October 14]
Another chaotic editorial meeting today. Nagahashi wanted to turn our club into a tabloid scandal sheet, but Suzumia fought hard for her cat cafe idea. When she talks about cats, her eyes light up completely. It's really cute.

We agreed on a dual cover. Now the pressure is on me to assemble the layout and make sure both sides look amazing.

Hoshida handed me a network dump earlier... he pretends to be a lazy slacker, but the code he writes is frighteningly advanced.

[October 15 - Morning]
Hiko told me something interesting on our morning walk: that 3rd-floor server was officially unplugged years ago. If packets are bouncing through it, someone plugged in an independent power source in the basement conduits. Suzumia gave me warm honey tea before 1st period. Her hands were trembling slightly with nervous excitement for the council audit today. I won't let her down.
